setups.title: $MINA Breaks Below Critical Support: Further Drop Expected
setups.technical_analysis: Price sits just below the 9‑EMA (0.125282) while staying above the 21‑EMA (0.122942), indicating short‑term bearish pressure. The MACD histogram is negative (-0.001006) and the MACD line is under its signal, reinforcing downside momentum. Stochastic K/D are in the low‑30s, suggesting the pair is not yet oversold and could slide toward the nearby support.
setups.market_context: Bitcoin is in a bullish trend on both 4H and 1D timeframes, and the overall market breadth is broadly positive, supporting risk‑on sentiment.
